name: provider
title: Provider
description: The single app-root wrapper — theme (next-themes), Base UI toasts, tooltip delays, and text direction in one mount-once component.

meta.whenToUse: Once, around your app root (layout.tsx) — every VegaStack component below it gets dark mode, working toast() calls, shared tooltip delays, and direction context.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anywhere below the root, or a second time — the bundled Toaster is a mount-once portal; pass toaster={false} if you must render your own.
